product.ta-l21.summary: The L21 combined a screen, keyboard and ISA slot in a portable computer.
product.ta-l21.history: The ISER collection holds a 1989 L21 with its manual and carrying bag. This sheet describes that configuration.
product.ta-l21.technical.configuration: The slot accepted half-length ISA cards. ISER’s transcription gives both a 16 MHz 80C286 and an NEC V30. The processor remains to be checked.
product.ta-l21.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-l21.technical.limitations: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
